CORE_DIRECTIVE.TITLE: LISL (Loop-based Instruction Scaling Logic): Empirical Efficiency, Code Quality, and Autonomous Tooling
CORE_DIRECTIVE.PURPOSE: Externalize state to disk and enforce strict instruction adherence via instruction files to combat conversational drift, context degradation, and memory bloat[cite: 10].

PILLAR.name: Task Complexity
PILLAR.DETAIL: Handles low-level engineering tasks including custom ARM7TDMI 16.16 fixed-point math, game physics, and graphics pipelines under strict hardware constraints (e.g., GBA Mode 1 tilemap rendering without FPU)[cite: 10].

PILLAR.name: Output Quality
PILLAR.DETAIL: Validates production-ready, warning-free codebases with zero destructive edits and autonomous self-auditing via embedded verification headers and timing notes[cite: 10].

PILLAR.name: Compounding Efficiency (TCR Multiplier)
PILLAR.DETAIL: Calculates Task Compression Rate (TCR = Cumulative Tokens / Completed Tasks), showing systematic optimization from early scaffolding down to 5.71 tokens/task in late-stage convergence[cite: 10].

WHITEPAPER_STEPS.STEP: Complete Small-Model Stress Test with NemoTron optimization[cite: 10].
Parse console logs, code diffs, and project summaries into Gemma for statistical analysis[cite: 10].
Draft final publication showcasing LISL as a scalable framework for low-parameter, high-complexity execution[cite: 10].

CORE_DIRECTIVE.TITLE: Local Instruction State Loop (LISL): Methodological Specification & Data Extraction Guide
CORE_DIRECTIVE.PURPOSE: Overcome attention drift, KV-cache explosion, and memory bandwidth bottlenecks by replacing cloud-dependent chat wrappers with structured markdown instruction files and dynamic state pruning[cite: 12].

INVENTOR_BACKGROUND.AUTHOR: BadgerMan9999 (BadgerSoft Productions)
INVENTOR_BACKGROUND.HISTORY: Learned DOS in 1984 at age 3 on a Delta computer with amber monochrome CRT[cite: 12], built first 386SX system at age 10.
INVENTOR_BACKGROUND.PHILOSOPHY: Efficiency on x86 systems; creating a deterministic file-bus architecture for agentic loops to bypass bloated commercial frameworks (LangGraph, AutoGen) and heavy API token overhead[cite: 12].

CORE_ARCH_MECHANICS.MECHANIC: Execution state passes between iterations exclusively via structured files rather than a continuous chat buffer[cite: 12].
Completed sub-tasks and redundant traces are aggressively purged; only active micro-chunks feed the next cycle[cite: 12].
Instruction sets compiled to match target model cognitive profiles and parameter constraints[cite: 12].
Air-gapped local execution bounded entirely by hardware resource limits[cite: 12].

MATHEMATICAL_METRIC.NAME: Task Compression Rate (TCR)
MATHEMATICAL_METRIC.FORMULA: TCR = (Total Completed Units of Work) / (Cumulative Token Consumption)
MATHEMATICAL_METRIC.BEHAVIOR: Negative token acceleration; TCR scales positively (exceeding 1.15+ during GBA architecture compilation) as problem spaces narrow and noise is eliminated[cite: 12].

HARDWARE_BOUNDARY_CONDITIONS.TIER: Gemma 4 12B QAT on Intel Core i5 8th Gen, 32GB DDR4 RAM, NVIDIA RTX 3050 6GB VRAM[cite: 12].
Qwen 3.5 validation tier for instruction adherence and compression efficiency[cite: 12].
Nemotron Nano 2B masterclass edge benchmark executing 37 continuous iterations[cite: 12].

FILE_EXTENSION_INNOVATION.PURPOSE: Windows file association script links .lisl directly to models inside LM Studio, LM Bionic, and Beledarian tools. Separates executable LISL instructions from passive .xml training files to prevent model confusion and ensure workspace truthfulness.
